subject: general
question: The popular ritual of ‘Kanya/Kumari Puja’ is held during which of the following festivals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sharad Navaratri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sharad Navratri **is **regarded **by **many devotees **to be the most **important **one and is also therefore called **Maha Navratri.**
 
• It is **celebrated **during the **Sharad period **i.e. **beginning **of **wintertime **so it is also referred to as Sharad or Shardiya Navratri. </strong&g
